p01-luis-is-tall.observed_description: Luis, short dark curly hair and clean-shaven, in a plain navy crew-neck T-shirt, khaki chinos and navy sneakers, steps through an open white interior doorway in a bright empty room with white walls and a light wooden floor, smiling at the camera with his left hand on the side of the frame; the top of his head is a few centimeters below the top of the door frame and he fills the doorway's height. Head to feet, centered.
p01-luis-is-tall.note: Usable with a deviation: he tilts his head sideways instead of bending it down under the frame, and the frame top stays just above his head, so the tall cue is 'his head almost reaches the top of the door' rather than 'he ducks'. It still reads as a tall man at 180 px and in the 4:5 tile; the user decides at Gate 2.

p02-sofia-is-short.observed_description: Sofia, hair in a high bun, in her bright blue blazer, white blouse, black trousers and black flats, stands at the right of a tall light-oak bookcase in a bright library with tall windows and pulls a red book from the top shelf with her right arm stretched up, smiling; a small two-step wooden stool stands in front of her, but her feet are on the floor behind it and her legs pass behind its seat.
p02-sofia-is-short.rejection: She is not standing on the stool: her feet are on the floor beside it, physically inconsistent with the stool's seat, and she again takes the book from the top shelf with ease because the bookcase was drawn to her reach. At phone size it reads as a woman taking a book next to an unused stool, not as a short woman. Two reach-based attempts failed, so a third would use another person for scale instead.
